glossary.scope: As used in sections 901.70 to 901.76 of the Revised Code:

glossary.definition: (B) "Livestock" means any animal generally used for food or in the production of food, including cattle, sheep, goats, rabbits, poultry, swine, and any other animal included by the director by rules adopted under section 901.72 of the Revised Code, alpacas, and llamas.
